faq.q: How much does Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire charge?
faq.a: Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire have offices?
faq.a: Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire?
faq.a: Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire names ten attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Thorsnes Bartolotta McGuire publishes 40 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
